hero.lede: For the last eight years I designed digital products and services, for pros and consumers, for all sorts of devices, for web and native, and always for people.

tiles.title: Keep it simple, stupid
tiles.body: The hard part is removing. It's not letting in anything on the screen, that doesn't serve a purpose. It's not letting the interface make people feel dumb,

tiles.title: Make it last
tiles.body: A system that survives the test of time, that the next team can work with, and the one in 10 years. And a design that doesn't look old tomorrow.

tiles.title: Team work makes the dream work
tiles.body: My best work happens in a room with engineers, experts and stakeholders, not alone in a Figma (or Claude) file.
